stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: When the Sinister Six take hostages at the Metro Bank, Carter and DeWolff are ordered to move in together. The two partners join the police fight against the escaped villains.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: DeWolff and Sergeant Carter take Flash and Harry on a police ride-along. Carter agrees with Flash that Spider-Man is a hero, while DeWolff argues that he goes too far.
stages.whoA: Sergeant Carter, her partner who cheers on Spider-Man
stages.whoB: DeWolff, his partner who thinks Spider-Man goes too far

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: During the mass breakout from Ryker's Island, Hammerhead calls Ox and Fancy Dan to his side while Montana stays behind. The two Enforcers escape together with him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man finds Fancy Dan and his little pal Ox caged in the Vault and teases them. Once the cells open, the two Enforcers join Silvermane's posse of prisoners hunting him.
stages.whoA: Ox, his cellblock partner in the Vault
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, his cellblock partner in the Vault

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: At the Thanksgiving parade, quarterback Flash calls an audible and pulls the Mustangs off their balloon to help. Rand follows his lead, and the team catches Gwen when Venom hurls her down.
stages.whoA: Rand, a Mustangs teammate who follows his call
stages.whoB: Flash, the quarterback who leads the Mustangs

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: On Valentine's Day, Flash begs Peter to kick him whenever he says something dumb in front of Sha Shan. She tells him she likes him for who he is, an honest guy, and they dance.
stages.whoA: Sha Shan, the girl he finally wins over
stages.whoB: Flash, the honest guy she agrees to dance with

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Glory comes to the fall formal as Harry's date after dumping Kenny. Kenny admits he was a jerk and begs for one more chance, and Glory takes him back.
stages.whoA: Kenny, the boyfriend she takes back at the formal
stages.whoB: Glory, the girlfriend he wins back with an apology
